cohort: Nulliparous women in Sweden with spontaneous or induced onset of labor at >34 weeks of gestation with a singleton fetus in cephalic presentation
finding: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy were not associated with altered labor duration among women with spontaneous onset of labor, but were associated with shorter labor duration among women who were induced.
mod_finding: Women with hypertensive disorders who were induced had a shorter duration of labor compared to normotensive women who were induced.
